Tomorrow’s FINAL FEC deadline is the most important of the entire
campaign. Let me explain.

Tomorrow at midnight we face our final FEC reporting deadline before
Election Day. It’s the last time we have to file our fundraising numbers
publicly for everyone to see. Our campaign set a $350,000 goal to keep us
on track, and here’s why:

📊 Recent polls show Republican John Sununu in the lead.

📡 National Republicans are outspending us 3-to-1 on the airwaves.

💰 There’s more than $60 million being spent to defeat us.

🗳️ Every dollar that we raise today determines what we can budget to
compete in the final 21 days until Election Day.

If we fall short now, we risk letting Republicans not only flip this seat
but lock up the Senate majority for a generation.

So much is on the line: Granite Staters’ hard-earned Social Security,
lowering the cost of health care, reproductive rights, and fighting back
against Trump’s reckless agenda.

We can only protect these priorities by beating Sununu in three weeks. I
need your help to stay competitive.

Republican hands?

This $350,000 goal isn’t arbitrary – it’s what we need to compete and win
over the next three weeks. If you’re able to help us reach it today, it
would be a massive help to everything we’re trying to accomplish. [ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261013_5._FcUPe&refcode=em20261013-5&t=1023&akid=9515%2E582294%2EO_R-5S ]I
would be very grateful for your $5 contribution.

Thank you,

Chris

[ stdin# ]Josh Shapiro for Pennsylvania
Derek,

Donald Trump is watching Pennsylvania for a reason. Hell, he’s coming to
Pennsylvania later this month for a reason:

If he gets his hands on the Governor’s office this year, there will be no
one to stop him from overturning a free and fair election here in
Pennsylvania and guarantee our electoral votes go to his chosen candidate
come 2028.

That’s what’s at stake in this election,
Derek. Not just Pennsylvania’s
future. But our entire country’s future. Our entire democracy’s future.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/17197?t=1001&akid=620%2E245147%2EOl6DDo ]So I need to ask: Will you make your first $5
donation right away to make sure we hold the line here in
the most important battleground state in the country?

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/17197?t=1002&akid=620%2E245147%2EOl6DDo ]Donate →

Look, I really wish it didn’t cost so much money to win an election.

But this is Pennsylvania. In 2024, we saw $1.2 BILLION worth of campaign
ads in the lead up to the election... and Republicans still won every
statewide election on the ballot.

That’s an eye-watering sum of money,
Derek. And since I’m one of
just two Democratic Governors nationwide running for reelection in a state
Trump won?

Pennsylvania is still at the very top of the GOP’s wish list.

[ https://act.joshshapiro.org/go/17197?t=1003&akid=620%2E245147%2EOl6DDo ]This is the point in the election when just one extra ad or one extra
organizer can swing an extraordinary amount of voters. So please, will you

name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: Hull showed up. Haaland didn’t. Then the poll came out.
body:
Plus: Mark got some bad news about Bigfoot | New episode for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/loTkDO5HoM0?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | | | | |
On Thursday night, Gregg Hull stood on the KOB stage next to an empty podium. On Sunday, the Albuquerque Journal’s new poll had him 7 points behind the woman who didn’t show up. Mark thinks the race is closer than that 7 makes it look, and he walks through the numbers to show why.
In Texas, the Democrat running for a critical Senate just spent 13 days off the campaign trail. And Mark learned that the Bigfoot film he has always wanted to believe in may have been rehearsed... a year earlier.
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/qjt6DjJXBxK?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
| | **HAALAND LEADS HULL 49 TO 42 and HER OWN PARTY IS HER SOFT SPOT**
The Journal reached 1,125 people for this poll, all by phone, and that is why Mark takes it more seriously than most.
The real news is under the topline. Hull is doing better in the Albuquerque metro than Republicans did in last year’s mayor’s race, and Haaland holds fewer Democrats than Hull holds Republicans. That number should worry her even if she wins, and Mark says why.
Hull’s problem is independents, and money. We also play the two new attack ads in this race, and one of them uses a clip from our show.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/Q3TtRI6Ot0B?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---
| | **TALARICO SPENT 13 DAYS OFF THE TRAIL, AND EL-SAYED WOULDN’T PICK ISRAEL OVER IRAN**
James Talarico’s campaign says he had the flu. Mark Penn, a Democratic strategist with 40 years in campaigns, says he has never seen a candidate do this in October.
In Michigan, Abdul El-Sayed was asked in a debate whether Israel or Iran is the bigger threat to the United States. He called it a ridiculous hypothetical. We play his answer and what a CNN panel said about it.

**🦶 A NEW DOCUMENTARY SAYS THE MOST FAMOUS BIGFOOT FILM WAS REHEARSED**
A reel shot in 1966, a year before the Patterson-Gimlin film, sat in a safe for decades. It shows a thinner Bigfoot walking through the woods and looking over its shoulder the same way.
Krysty broke the news to Mark on air. He had Grover Krantz as a professor at Washington State, and Krantz spent years arguing that a person could not easily fake that walk. Mark is not giving up until he sees the film.
---
| [STREAM NOW](https://us.list-manage.com/15xqfOnaQXZ?e=567664f14c&c2id=f551a60afe6194f7ea2dcf92821ad62e)
---

clean_body: You hit $45,000 over a holiday weekend | | | | Derek, Late last night, we hit our goal of $45,000. I saw it come in, and I'm grateful for every one of you. Thank you. Meeting these goals is not a given. It only happened because you showed up. Here's the thing: Congressman Tom Tiffany didn't slow down either. He has received over $34 million from 2 far-right billionaire families. Trump gave him a “Complete and Total Endorsement” last week. The MAGA movement is trying to rally behind him. The polls still show us in a dead heat. 9% of voters are still undecided. We know this race will be close. The last three presidential elections in Wisconsin were each decided by less than one point. 21 days from now, Wisconsin votes. And whether we win or lose will come down to just a few votes. So we're going to campaign as hard as we can until then. Thank you for standing with us, for believing in this, and for being on this team. I couldn't be more grateful. Sincerely, David P.S. Hitting one goal doesn't end the fight. Our final reporting deadline is already coming up. We need to get a head start on fundraising. Unlike far too many politicians today, Marie didn’t run for office to get rich. She ran because policies coming out of D.C. were ignoring small business owners and tradespeople like her and her husband. Like so many of us, Marie is tired of the mudslinging between parties that keeps us from solving problems for regular people. She’s not a multi-millionaire who self-funds her campaigns. She is working to stop large corporations from continuing to be able to rip us off. Marie believes good ideas come from anyone, no matter their education, occupation, or political party. Let me tell you why this matters so much to me. In the late 1960s, I watched corruption hollow out my country before my own eyes. In Mexico, a government propped up by insiders and backroom deals shut down my university, closed my father’s business, and put more than fifty families out of work. _I didn’t leave because I stopped loving my country — I left because when corruption takes hold, ordinary people lose the chance to build something honest for themselves and their families. _ That’s why stopping backroom deals and corruption means so much to me, and to Marie. Marie built her business with her own two hands, working alongside her husband as they fixed cars and made an honest living. She knows what it takes to make payroll, to fight through red tape, and to keep going when the odds are stacked against you. She didn’t lobby her way to success or rely on a kickback. She earned it the hard way — the way so many working people in this district do every single day. **Congress is full of politicians who treat public office like a personal business: cutting deals for donors and insiders while working families get left behind. Marie has promised me, and you, that she will never be one of them. ** I did not raise my daughter to chase power. I raised her to believe every family deserves the agency to build a good life through hard work—without corruption standing in the way, and without politicians deciding who gets to succeed and who doesn’t. That is what this election is about. Not politics as usual, but whether working people get a fair shot at the American Dream my family came here looking for. **I hope you’ll join me in supporting Marie Gluesenkamp Pérez for Congress — not because she’s my daughter, but because we deserve leaders who answer to us, not to the insiders in Washington. ** **[Please make a contribution online today.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141352552/653316303/-995582223?refcode=261013-jose&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NTkyOCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlZWJmNjU1ZC03MGM3LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sKjJCh8Xv683PsZUfiWQLE_53Rhkl_60g9KRRG7wc0I=)**

Your vote is safe. And we’re going to keep it that way. → We’ve been in close contact with law enforcement, the Governor, the Secretary of State, and local registrars across the state. Protecting your right to vote is a team effort in California, and we are prepared for any possibility. → We’ve also taken new steps to strengthen those protections. California just passed new laws that make it a crime to unlawfully seize ballots, and that if a seizure is attempted, my office must be notified immediately so we can act to stop it. To put it simply: If you can imagine it, we’re ready for it. When it comes to protecting your fundamental right to vote — from the President, a law-breaking sheriff, or anyone else who tries to interfere — I’ll never stop fighting for your rights and our shared democracy. = If you’ve saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = The right to vote is the right from which all other rights flow, and you have my word that I’m doing everything in my power to ensure no one can take it from you. name: Rep. Gloria Johnson
subject: 🎙️NEW EPISODE: "Hope is cheap." Tequila Johnson on building real Black political power in Tennessee
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY FRIENDS OF GLORIA JOHNSON, LISA SORENSEN, TREASURER
body:
Tequila Johnson doesn't believe in selling people hope. She believes in discipline, strategy, and building power,

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/4b1ace3cd67c/stand-up-against-the-shameful-gop-power-grab-7363933?e=dc5f639d62)

|

| |

Hey friends,
Tequila Johnson doesn't believe in selling people hope. She believes in discipline, strategy, and building power, and after this conversation I think she might be right.

[**[CLICK HERE to LISTEN NOW**]](https://us.list-manage.com/mmgr0Rg8Fg4?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)****
[**Listen or watch now wherever you get your podcasts. 🎧**](https://us.list-manage.com/4DSByIoCAlN?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)

Tequila is the founder and leader of [The Equity Alliance](https://us.list-manage.com/13m48nm2csu?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0), which is working to build Black political power across Tennessee through direct service, political education, and yes, really good brunches.
We talk about how The Equity Alliance started, why "egoless leadership" matters, what happened at the Capitol during the special session that split up Memphis, and what it takes for candidates of color to run, win, and survive in office. She also tells me why she won't tell anyone to just "vote blue no matter who," and what she offers instead.
Early voting starts**tomorrow, October 14** and runs through October 29, and **Election Day is November 3.** Voter registration is closed for this election, but you can still knock doors, make calls, and drive folks to the polls.**Find your polling location**[**here**](https://us.list-manage.com/b6KMzqxdfdA?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0) and make a plan to vote early if you’re able!
Learn how to get involved with The Equity Alliance at[ theequityalliance.org](https://us.list-manage.com/4aB1lFzljih?e=dc5f639d62&c2id=395895520870fa96cf2587ee59cac4d0)This one made me think, and I hope it does the same for you.
Thank you for being here,
Gloria

| If you read one email today, make it this one
---
_You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you only want our most important email updates,[click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/108?t=2&akid=3495%2E259176%2E-QKPlN) If you'd like to unsubscribe, [click here.](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/109?t=3&akid=3495%2E259176%2E-QKPlN)_

Hey Peter, it’s Congresswoman Lucy McBath for GA-06. We’re short on time so I’ll make this quick:

Tonight, Blue Amp Action and I are up against the last FEC fundraising deadline before the election and I’m _humbly_ asking you to help me defend my purple seat from MAGA and take back Congress. | [Donate $20 >>](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/17001?source=SL_EM_FR_2026.10.14_McBath-Deadline_B1_F1_S2_C1_180AC-360DON_T2&t=4&akid=3495%2E259176%2E-QKPlN)
---
Ever since I flipped this seat in 2018, Republicans have tried everything they can to get rid of me. Getting special interests to dump millions into our state, trying to redraw my district (3 times!), and filling the airwaves with lies and distortions.
The reason those dirty tricks haven’t worked is because people like you have stood up and chipped in $5, $10, or $20 to defend this purple seat.
You know I don’t like doing this, but the honest truth is that Democrats like me won’t win back Congress without grassroots supporters like you. [Can you split $10 or $20 between my campaign and Blue Amp Action before the October 14th FEC deadline tonight? ]( https://act.blueampaction.com/go/17003?c0=.cZUMNJ&t=5&akid=3495%2E259176%2E-QKPlN)

---
I really appreciate it,

Lucy
[](https://act.blueampaction.com/go/16067?source=SL_EM_FR_2026.10.14_McBath-Deadline_B1_F1_S2_C1_180AC-360DON_T2&t=11&akid=3495%2E259176%2E-QKPlN)

We’re facing a critical moment in American history, which means what we do right now will define the future of our nation and our world.

Here at Blue Amp, we’re dedicated to uplifting the movers and shakers who will defend our shared democratic values and beat back against right-wing authoritarianism. We’re amplifying good candidates who are passionate about protecting civil rights, making life affordable, and leaving a better world for future generations.

The midterms are coming up, and we can’t do this work without you. With your support, we'll work to halt the right-wing agenda and support strong Democrats who will fight for us across the country.

name: Roy Cooper
subject: Thank you in advance, Peter
body:
re: our last FEC deadline of the campaign
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1662&source=&t=1&akid=4535%2E124072%2EsymLuC) | | | |
---
Peter,
How fortunate would you feel knowing you played a key role in helping elect a Democrat to the U.S. Senate from North Carolina for the first time in almost 20 years?
How good would it feel to know that _your_ support meant we had the resources to ramp up our Get Out the Vote operation just as early voting begins tomorrow?
How happy would you be knowing that the action you took **today** helped us flip the Senate and finally put a check on the Trump Administration?
**I know every single one of these achievements can happen, but only if we have the resources ... and that means we need to reach our critical $3,000,000 FEC fundraising goal tonight and bring this campaign across the finish line.[_So please, Peter, will you chip in before the midnight deadline?_](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1662&amount=5&t=8&akid=4535%2E124072%2EsymLuC)**
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [DONATE $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1662&amount=5&t=9&akid=4535%2E124072%2EsymLuC)
---
| | [DONATE $25](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1662&amount=25&t=10&akid=4535%2E124072%2EsymLuC)
---
| | [DONATE $50](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14275?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1662&amount=50&t=11&akid=4535%2E124072%2EsymLuC)
---
| | [OTHER AMOUNT](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1662&t=12&akid=4535%2E124072%2EsymLuC)
---
Whatever we raise by midnight will be a matter of public record. It’s the last time before Election Day folks will be able to see how much we’ve raised and how many donations we’ve received.
**If we fall short of our ambitious goal, the GOP will see it as a sign of weakness – and likely up their spending and their attacks accordingly.**
We’ll be forced to scale back our GOTV program. Make tough choices about the final ads we can run. Maybe lose our chance to win this seat, take back the Senate and hold President Trump and his MAGA enablers accountable.
**Peter, we can’t let that happen.[_Please, will you chip in $5 or anything you can right now to help us hit our final FEC fundraising goal of the campaign? I need your help to show the GOP that we have what it takes to flip NC blue._](https://act.roycooper.com/go/14264?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1662&amount=5&t=13&akid=4535%2E124072%2EsymLuC)**
Thank you in advance for your support. I can’t do it without you.

Roy Cooper
| |
* * *
[](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1662&t=2&akid=4535%2E124072%2EsymLuC)
Democrat Roy Cooper is running for U.S. Senate to help take back the Majority for Democrats. North Carolina is Democrats’ best chance to flip a seat from red to blue — the path to stopping Republicans in Washington starts here.

National Republicans will target North Carolina as a key battleground and invest heavily in defeating us.

Cooper is a former state legislator, Attorney General, and most recently Governor of North Carolina. North Carolina will be the most competitive Senate election of 2026, and Cooper enters the race as the most formidable candidate of either party.

Cooper’s signature achievements include helping to expand Medicaid and helping make NC the top state for business by creating thousands of jobs and growing the clean energy economy.

[**_Donate today to help win this seat and flip the Senate blue._**](https://act.roycooper.com/go/15912?refcode=email_fr_pros_jtk1662&source=&t=3&akid=4535%2E124072%2EsymLuC)

Peter, it’s Jon. I’m humbly asking: [**Can you rush $5 to my reelection campaign today?**](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-oct26.FRbHBd&refcode=em261014-2-f&utm_campaign=em261014-2-f&amount=5&t=2&akid=3079%2E5691347%2EpG5mOj)
I don’t love asking for money, but the truth is this will be one of the most competitive and expensive U.S. Senate elections, and the most important fundraising deadline of my campaign so far is at midnight.
I’ll explain more in a minute, but if you’re ready to do something right now to make a difference, please use this link to give today:
[**https://act.electjon.com/go/october**](https://act.electjon.com/go/5243?c0=ossoff-em-oct26.FRbHBd&refcode=em261014-2-f&utm_campaign=em261014-2-f&t=3&akid=3079%2E5691347%2EpG5mOj)
Ok, here’s the situation.
I am the only Democratic Senator running for reelection in a state Trump won in 2024.
That makes me MAGA’s #1 target. _The GOP and their Super PACs will spend hundreds of millions of dollars against me._
National Republicans have *vastly* more resources than National Democrats right now. _MAGA is sitting on a $657 million war chest._
And when our fundraising numbers go public after this deadline, if Trump and MAGA think we look weak, you can bet they’ll flood the airwaves with even more attack ads.
**We can’t afford to show anything but strength at this moment.**
We have to show everyone that our movement in Georgia is thriving and unstoppable — that we have what it takes to build the strongest voter outreach and mobilization program our state has ever seen. Because that’s what it’s going to take to win this race.
That’s why I have to ask:

name: Gina Hinojosa
subject: In February, they didn’t think I had a chance
body:
The Houston Chronicle just endorsed me, and what they wrote about Abbott says everything you need to know.
# [](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)[](https://ginafortexas.com/?refcode=em_ms_gh_header)
Peter,
**Yesterday morning, the Houston Chronicle, the paper of record in Texas’s largest city, endorsed me for governor.**
[](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1356?c0=em_ms_gh_20261014_1_houston.vyJBcS&refcode=em20261014-2419&t=1&akid=2419%2E299639%2Ei6rrQw)
I want to be honest about something: when I met with their editorial board in February, they didn’t think Greg Abbott had much to worry about. They said so right in the endorsement. I was a state rep with little name recognition outside Austin, running against a three-term incumbent with a $106 million war chest.
Eight months later, they’ve endorsed me.
**But what stuck with me most in their endorsement wasn’t what they said about me. It was what they said about how much Greg Abbott has changed.**
Texans first met Abbott in the ’90s, when he ran for judge in Houston. Back then he came across as a moderate, Bush-era Republican who even picked up Democratic votes. Three decades later, the Chronicle calls him a “relentless, hardcore MAGA standard-bearer.”
Look at what he’s done with the power he’s been given:
* Texas currently has the most people without health insurance, the most people being disconnected from their electricity, and the most bankruptcies of any state.
* He stripped Texas communities of local control.
* And he’s taken care of the billionaires who fund him:
* A $1 million check from a gas tycoon whose company cashed in during Winter Storm Uri.
* $12 million from a Pennsylvania billionaire while Abbott pushed vouchers that drain money from rural public schools.
* A billion dollars a year in tax breaks for data centers.

**That’s the question at the heart of this race: which Texans does Greg Abbott serve? It isn’t working families.**
When I left that editorial board meeting, I told them I think people are tired of fighting. Tired of a government that works for the powerful instead of for them. **After 30 years of one-party rule, Texans are ready for change.**
Early voting starts October 19th. Abbott still has $17 million to spend, and he’ll use every dollar to keep things exactly the way they are.
If you’ve been waiting to make your first contribution, let this be the moment. [**Will you chip in $15 to help us bring our message to every Texan before early voting starts?**](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/1374?c0=em_ms_gh_20261014_1_houston.e8mET7&refcode=em20261014-2419&t=3&akid=2419%2E299639%2Ei6rrQw)
[Donate »](https://act.ginafortexas.com/go/625?c0=em_ms_gh_20261014_1_houston.Cyche5&amount=5&refcode=em20261014-2419&t=22&akid=2419%2E299639%2Ei6rrQw)
Thank you,
Gina

Arkansas U.S. Senate candidate Hallie Shoffner seriously needs to drop the moderate Democrat act, as Loomer Unleashed has uncovered multiple photos of Shoffner posing with individuals wearing "No Kings" T-shirts. The No Kings organization has very publicly embraced the policy of impeaching and removing President Trump, despite the fact that he is a democratically elected _president_ and not a king.
Instagram posts from July show Shoffner posing in multiple photos with individuals donning the obnoxiously colored yellow "No Kings" T-shirts. Shoffner posed for these pictures at an Indivisible Arkansas anti-Trump, anti-Tom Cotton protest that took place just days after July 4th.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/4aed3d5c-3780-4aeb-b6c2-3db3df76e580?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

---|---|---
The photos were posted on two Instagram accounts: [Indivisible Arkansas's](https://substack.com/redirect/55a92a54-ff54-4e5d-85ce-232ef06ed7c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and [Hallie Shoffner's official](https://substack.com/redirect/1e606069-f860-4413-9947-059e2bd71a75?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) account.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d9aceabd-5892-477b-b7ce-99edb0ef5a6b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

No Kings is very open about its desire to impeach, convict, and remove President Trump, who beat VP Kamala Harris in the [2024 presidential election](https://substack.com/redirect/a9a293f5-d0fd-4c55-b93b-efee54ef3caf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by almost 2.5 million popular votes and 86 electoral votes. A flyer for its March anti-Trump protest on Capitol Hill reads:
"Impeach, Convict, Remove the Regime."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/a0521fa4-2d6d-41d6-80e5-5c6c105fe86b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
It is also important to note that, as we approach the midterm elections, No Kings has scheduled another anti-Trump nationwide protest, with the logo for the upcoming march reading:
"Impeach, Convict, Remove."
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/f1ac169f-4bf1-4be4-af07-1d20300785bf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Some of Loomer Unleashed's most intense protest footage in Washington, D.C. occurred during No Kings events where numerous attendees held up "Impeach Trump"and "86-47" posters.
And who can forget in April 2025, when we captured numerous bused-in "protesters" disembarking in Washington, D.C. for that day's No Kings protest?
Even more disturbing was the fact that numerous of these buses were filled with terrorist-sympathizing individuals wearing keffiyehs and burqas while shouting "Free Palestine."
We also captured on video numerous Islamic Republic of Iran flags flown during March's No Kings protest in Washington, D.C. These "defenders of democracy" openly support a country with no elections, and it is shameful.
No Kings marches in our nation's capital also featured numerous threats against President Trump's life, including a disgusting, inflammatory, borderline-illegal "86-47" poster calling for orange bloodstains during the June 2025 No Kings event. No Kings protesters even had the audacity to hang an "86-47" sign on the White House fence during the Fourth of July.
These No Kings events have also been championed by the most radical left members of Congress. During the September 2025 No Kings protest, for which House and Senate Democrats literally shut the government down, Loomer Unleashed confronted purple-haired Rep. Rosa DeLauro (D-Conn.) about shutting down the government for a protest. DeLauro did not care about the chaos the left was causing during our questioning.
We have also taken footage of No Kings protesters screaming "F-- ICE." This is as Shoffner previously stated she would vote to defund ICE, and then lied to voters, claiming she never made those statements, despite literally being caught on video saying she would defund ICE.
All of this is critical, because if Shoffner were to win her Senate race, and the Democrats were to retake the U.S. House of Representatives, it is extremely likely Shoffner would be voting in the Senate on whether to convict and remove President Trump from office, yet another nakedly political attack on the president with no basis in "[treason, bribery, or other high crimes and misdemeanors](https://substack.com/redirect/0e758b84-bcf6-42fe-9671-6ded6ac7e1ac?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."
Given Shoffner's associations with the No Kings protesters, it looks incredibly likely she would vote to convict President Trump. This scary but plausible scenario further proves that Arkansas voters can't trust Shoffner to be their next United States senator.

## Six Flags Halts Coasters after Rider's Death
Six Flags [temporarily closed](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSpCAURb9GM7oA6W4NCDYxm003tBAu-naeYgHTtn-_NfMLm9-6dc758zF9OGLal99ug60xTTvOwqgVeSr0juyWUrNbEK7V-U-EmClMWuqHUFIoMzlf6YXJuDbYCGh0Lax6Dmp46k6qdrVPg0FG0_uIaHSvA_p5HuSsEeS9V0NL9vtPSWWUlObe3_pH15uH6wDjw12pxkgEqinf_iba64rIV3oh33zaWrZrrUdpul-NHhs9nud5i-k9fxXaUcr3ptEjU0SpF6PRY6G3-BETnlNBETkxIwufXKnIRWxfXOlgiMPlzyJcrMgiwAW-BO2eAvYqFqS8kGuzDcdJzFQez8bIZXPEP2D1P3u-rP4XAAD__8vVjvk) nine of its biggest roller coasters at six parks across North America after a rider was thrown to his death from the Goliath coaster at Six Flags Over Georgia on Monday. The rider, identified by police as [Hassan Jihad Ibn Kariem](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkDuS2zAMQE9DdfDwZ4kuWKRRt2lTarACKDGhRQ-J2OvbZ7RXSIMGmDd479fH8oG55GP7iXeOkupy8KsXFuG29PyVCm5dGm5M7x3XP0ypZVqstiMYDcYvuEp-8uJxoJiYLbuBo5lu5jZZp82wx_Uz-KCv2lma0hhS8J8UrCPtJjO6mxlyPHlGG2-09tdwCaMLfkTH7Fe6GqO8ZspS2-V3zYfsnMq7Prld1nofStxFHl25H8rOys7H-1G7nCtl5xOs7Gz0OZyy898Op6Gyc89f8K0HhASvvQJlJsAk3CBhOatAavUOWy0ZZYdWS-EGa8V-3mQiwA4oBQ9BEMZ156bsPLRIj1cuJfdxUl5vd8zl-1f5z8TPaP8FAAD__xXwkD4), a 42-year-old Atlanta Public Schools employee, was riding with his son while his wife and daughter watched from the ground. Witnesses said he came out of his seat and [struck the train several times](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2upDAQBODTQGZkG_MXONiE7G26Iepnt6F3DB7ZvTDcfjVzhReXVKqv_nwtX0CRjvU37Gg5pOXAq0RkxrwUeoUIa-EMK_p7A_dAHzL5RUvdCyWFMgs4phMXA7W3AVFjW6NVw6SmQbdS1Zvtegidb1FrPSrplZ-kk85LOX1_wxB0Tfbdp6QySkrTjc3Yt6PpoUU0zndKVUaiJ065-Zvo4A1DvNOJuXFpr6PdmJ-lan9Veq70fF1XE9Lr7XjnlZ45w4mx0vMORxEBGKIIEKMIOe2i0Et8mCKnGDELl6AwZlGekB9FbClnCjcdq8AbL-IDSxHgXPp3cKmz9c-LYqTSD5WR6w4UP7v4h3eeVv8PAAD__9VMjmM) before being thrown from the ride. Several other passengers were hurt. Goliath, which [tops out at 70 mph](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1uwyAUhZ8Gb1j8BTsDQxdv6drRuoGLfVsSIqB28vaV8wrdjnSkc_R9X5f5ApTovnzCDV2Leb7jXhO2hmWu9IwJltoKLBheK_gfDLFQmJVQlkvBpZnBN9pwNtAFFxEV6g6dHM7yPCgtZLe6weohDlYEfbXRjojRQhTaX3XQEpXpyB17UkgjhTCnsR-tHo0FjWh8OEnJjMBALZf-O9O9rRjTK29Yep9vXXJra4_K9AdTE1PTvu-9v9aD4-iZmo7I1FTpyd88vFBA7lOuvwUrXzCXhYCXnBIW7jPUhoUHhLYyNXXFhcdOKVG1AzNiuQGl93P7p7DNqb8AAAD__0tHgew) and 200 feet, remains shut down while police investigate. The closures elsewhere include Nitro in New Jersey and Fury 325 in North Carolina, with no reopening dates set.
## Guilfoyle Out as Ambassador to Greece
Kimberly Guilfoyle resigned Tuesday as U.S. ambassador to Greece [after the White House](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMGupCAURL8Gdxq4IrYLFrNx17OdpUG44J1G6QDTjn__4vuFt6ukkqqc8-e5PA1FOsJvs6OuPi0HniVirZiXQv99NKHUbAK6azP2hc5ncgtwUK3grZCLsZU-uEjTOO0RAfsGtRgnMY3Qc9Fseh1W1Q9uUgrkNMIolbO9s94OMACOvCF97wkupOBcDo_uofqHVKZHlNYNQjDJ0VFNufub6Kgb-nilD-bOpr2Jeqv1XVj_i8HMYD7Ps7NruTnunsF8Rwbzi_YVc7za8I-iT1fENmOhcLRmX00pxqXchoxokcHcZO3eJ8VIRY1M8rAbit-H9YeePhq-AgAA__9Nh34_) asked her to step down in the wake of reports that she asked a political donor for help with her debts and accepted other gifts. _" I didn't like what I read," _President Trump said. Her resignation comes five days after reports that Guilfoyle asked a Trump donor to [wire $100,000](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL_upCAURp9GOwwg_isotrGbbbc0V7jo3QExwIzj229mX-FXf8mXc86fx_IA8nRsvyGgLi4uB17ZYymYlkwf52HLJcGG9t7BPNG6RHaRXPZMcCbUAqbQGxcFtdUOUWJboxbDJKZBtlzUu-ZSrSsfjOQdjHbikzDT1K29HVvg3YA16e-f4EIJzlU3NmPfjqqHFlEZ2wlRKY6WSkzN30hH2dH5O74xNSaG2uu9lDNX7a9KzpWcr-tqXPx8Pb57JeczeipkciXnkl7hZJCfmT0prJj8zbYXeRdvjyxhpu1gW0I0yCCskDPYmNi1U0G2x1dGZuLhKIVcJ23Pi7yn3A-V4lsA8v-Jyg9DvrX8FwAA__8f74vD) to her American Express account before her 2025 confirmation hearing, offering access to administration officials in return. The donor says he never paid. Guilfoyle, the former fiancee of Donald Trump Jr., called the allegations [false and promised](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DHSmzAQBeDTiG49khBgCoo0dH_alMxirWBjgRxpscPtM-QKf7PNznzz3vv1NX0hR96Xn7jRICFNO31KJBHKU-G_IeJSJONC_lzx8SQfMvvJatuC0WDchA_hN00OKz8EIkt1RYPpetN3ttamWoe5n_u26zsdOutcg66ZddMH8q5r57bXFQ-XZ7RxRmvX3G_3tr67Fmsi9_CNMcpp8iwp334n3mWlEM_0pnx7pK2KwyryKqr-oeyo7Lifr1Tkeik7XrCyo9HXqZUdjwJXQ2XHJ28z5XjCcnAM6YwEfw6WArjNWAr6lOGSAINQhlemUo5MEHLa4LOyEKzpKAQflhUQPAXGXWCjUnAhZccqD_714Ri5tJ1yetmQ4__M8s2p34P9FwAA___TO5S7) to "vigorously defend my name, my reputation, and my integrity."

Hundreds of French supermarkets lost their fresh and frozen stock after hackers [remotely cranked](https://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkL1urDAQhZ_GdCCP8fJTuLgN3d42JRrsMThrYGVPluzbR84rpBmNdKTv6Dsf9_mOIYZj_Y87GfbnfNCVIzFTmnP49hHXzAlXcu8N7YOcT8HNSqquBlmDntFyeNGssXLGEylqKzLQjzD2qpVQbWZcBnJ-WWD0tCjr7U2C11qONNieAKtgCg8kaJBS34Zm6NpBd9gSaetuAEJLcoHP1Hye4eCNfHyfL0qNPfcqmo35mUX7T6hJqOm6rsYeiy2hUFNBCzWBLKcVavIJD0t1_npS2jE9iOtiVtv3QgmZy18kV8q1D4lys_Eeq2Tc8woxhtz1Qst1xxB_-_mPs72M-gkAAP__tOGCrA) internet-connected store refrigerators and freezers up to 122 degrees overnight Sunday. subject: My decision

body:
I know we’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different. With elections coming this November, the stakes are higher than they have ever been. The fate of our democracy hangs in the balance.
Hey folks, it’s Mark Kelly.
Seven years ago, I was making a decision about whether I was going to run for the Senate.
I knew it would be a lot of work. A lot of time away from home. A lot of time away from family. I knew it wouldn’t be easy.
But after two years of Donald Trump and a Republican-held Senate doing just about everything he wanted, I knew I couldn’t sit on the sidelines. I had to do something.
So, I ran. And, somehow, we won. And then we had to turn around and run all over again to win a full term after that. But thanks to your support, we won that one, too.
I’m grateful every day that I get to wake up, walk out the door, and defend our people, our democracy, and our Constitution. It’s one of the greatest honors of my life. And I’ve never forgotten that I wouldn’t be here without your help.
I know we’ve been in some tough fights before, but this one is different. With elections coming this November, the stakes are higher than they have ever been. The fate of our democracy hangs in the balance.
After everything that’s already happened, I wish I didn’t have to ask you for more. But that’s what I need to do.
**[I’m asking you to split a donation between Chris Pappas and me. We’re going to do everything we can to take back Congress this November, and Chris Pappas needs your help. I just hope you know that I wouldn’t be asking if this wasn’t important.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20261014_1._hRhwf&refcode=em20261014-1&t=1&akid=9510%2E582294%2E21gkGz)**

Thank you.
Mark

Hi – I know you’ve heard a lot from my team and me over the past few days, so please forgive me. Sending this email to you this early in the morning is the last thing I want to do, but I have to.
We’re falling short of our $2.5 million goal, so **[_I need you to chip in your first donation right now to help us get back on track. Today is the last day to have your donation 2X-matched, so please, don’t delay._](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141356345/653326050/418295699?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=email_fr_gmailnd_jtk6936&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZmZjMGRiZC1jNGM3LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sp1yn526PdDIy4Jh_7I4yF2wxxQWMhsVlvu0YZKOOtU=)**
Our campaign has been mounting a full court press for months. We went up on TV with ads early to spread our message. We also invested heavily in our field program to start having meaningful conversations with voters as soon as we could. In a race this important, with the stakes so high, we aren’t letting a moment go to waste.

**But this also means that we’re spending through a significant amount of resources.** We’ve even overshot our budget in some places to make sure we’re reaching and persuading the Ohioans who will decide this election.
Folks are clearly resonating with our message, but crypto's most powerful super PAC is flooding Ohio with another dark money cash infusion to run vicious attack ads that lie about me and my record. **This will turn the tides against us, unless we can raise more money and reach more people – quickly. And with early voting underway in Ohio, every day we don’t scale up means thousands of voters we could miss.**
**[_That’s why this goal is so crucial, and why some generous folks have agreed to match all gifts made by midnight tonight. This is the final FEC deadline of our campaign, so I have to ask: Please, will you give $5 or whatever you can to help us hit our $2.5 million goal before the midnight deadline, win in Ohio, and flip the Senate?_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141356346/653326051/418295699?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=email_fr_gmailnd_jtk6936&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY0NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZmZjMGRiZC1jNGM3LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sp1yn526PdDIy4Jh_7I4yF2wxxQWMhsVlvu0YZKOOtU=)**
We can't retreat in the face of the data center developers and crypto bros. Thank you.

Sherrod

Hi Peter,

As election day nears, James Talarico is letting his "moderate" mask slip.

When asked at a recent campaign event who his favorite drag queen was, he didn't miss a beat - instantly rattling "their" name off like he'd been asked his favorite color.

That video has gone viral online, racking up millions of views on social media.

Talarico has spent this entire campaign trying to sell Texas voters on a moderate, Bible-quoting version of himself, and videos like this are the LAST thing Talarico's campaign wants getting out to Texas voters.

Texas voters outside Austin won't buy his facade, not once they see the real Talarico instead of the campaign-trail version.

And right now in Michigan, Democrat U.S. Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed is running the same playbook, holding town halls in Lansing, Grand Rapids, Detroit, Flint, and Macomb, hoping moderate suburban voters forget he wants abortion legal through all nine months.

My name is Kristan Hawkins, and I'm the President of Students for Life Action. You can think of us as the grassroots arm of the Pro-Life Movement.

Peter, here's my problem.

You and I can't rely on the national media to tell the truth about these politicians' abortion extremism.

So it's up to grassroots folks like you and me to hold them accountable.
That's exactly what I want to do with my rapid response counter-protests at as many candidate events as possible in our targeted races.

Then, when he spoke at Baylor University - a Baptist school - our team was on the ground to ensure attendees heard the truth about his anti-Biblical, pro-abortion stance.

Do you remember, back in 2024, when our students walked into a Kamala Harris rally in Wisconsin, held up a cross, and got mocked from the stage for it?

A video went viral of Kamala on stage, talking about abortion "rights" and overturning Roe v. Wade, denouncing Christians who said "Christ is King," and responding to our students with "You guys are at the wrong rally."

I've seen it time and time again.

These are exactly the moments on the campaign trail that can swing an entire election.

One month from today, on Tuesday, November 3rd, voters across the nation will decide who controls Congress for the next two years - and who has the momentum heading into the critical 2028 presidential cycle.

Talarico, El-Sayed, and all pro-abortion politicians know a camera catching them off-script is worth more than any ad buy. That's exactly why they're not publishing their schedules more than a day or two out.

So my team has to be ready before they announce, not after.

That means canvassers who can redirect on short notice and students who'll show up with signs and cameras of their own.

Talarico has spent this entire campaign trying to sell Texas voters on a moderate, Bible-quoting version of himself, and videos like this are the LAST thing Talarico's campaign wants getting out to Texas voters. Texas voters outside Austin won't buy his facade, not once they see the real Talarico instead of the campaign-trail version. And right now in Michigan, Democrat U.S. Senate candidate Abdul El-Sayed is running the same playbook, holding town halls in Lansing, Grand Rapids, Detroit, Flint, and Macomb, hoping moderate suburban voters forget he wants abortion legal through all nine months. My name is Kristan Hawkins, and I'm the President of Students for Life Action. You can think of us as the grassroots arm of the Pro-Life Movement. Peter, here's my problem. You and I can't rely on the national media to tell the truth about these politicians' abortion extremism. So it's up to grassroots folks like you and me to hold them accountable. That's exactly what I want to do with my rapid response counter-protests at as many candidate events as possible in our targeted races. ? Last month, our Pro-Life Generation activists launched the first stop of a 100-church flyering campaign at a church right in Talarico's back yard. Then, when he spoke at Baylor University - a Baptist school - our team was on the ground to ensure attendees heard the truth about his anti-Biblical, pro-abortion stance. Do you remember, back in 2024, when our students walked into a Kamala Harris rally in Wisconsin, held up a cross, and got mocked from the stage for it? A video went viral of Kamala on stage, talking about abortion "rights" and overturning Roe v. Wade, denouncing Christians who said "Christ is King," and responding to our students with "You guys are at the wrong rally." I've seen it time and time again. These are exactly the moments on the campaign trail that can swing an entire election. One month from today, on Tuesday, November 3rd, voters across the nation will decide who controls Congress for the next two years - and who has the momentum heading into the critical 2028 presidential cycle. Talarico, El-Sayed, and all pro-abortion politicians know a camera catching them off-script is worth more than any ad buy. That's exactly why they're not publishing their schedules more than a day or two out. So my team has to be ready before they announce, not after. That means canvassers who can redirect on short notice and students who'll show up with signs and cameras of their own. None of that comes free, and none of it waits for a fundraising deadline. ? Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

name: MassDems featuring Senator Adam Gomez & Senator Pavel Payano
subject: Celebrating Hispanic Heritage Month
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Massachusetts Democratic State Committee Massachusetts Democratic Party
body:
| | | |
---
| | | Dear Friends, Hispanic Heritage Month is a time to celebrate the rich history, vibrant culture, resilience and countless contributions of Latino communities across Massachusetts and our nation. It is a time to honor the generations who came before us, the sacrifices they made, and the dreams they carried so that future generations could have greater opportunities. This year, however, our celebration comes at a time when many Latino families are experiencing fear and uncertainty. As the Trump Administration pursues policies that threaten to separate families and leave immigrant communities feeling unwelcome, we must remind our neighbors that they are valued, that they belong, and that they are not alone. Our communities have overcome tremendous challenges throughout history, and we will continue to meet these moments with courage, unity, and hope. As State Senators, we are proud to stand with our Latino neighbors, not just during Hispanic Heritage Month, but every day. We remain committed to protecting all families, expanding opportunities, defending the dignity of every person, and building a Commonwealth where everyone has access to the American Promise. Our heritage is a source of pride. Our diversity is a source of strength. And our greatest promise lies in what we can accomplish together. This Hispanic Heritage Month, let us celebrate our heritage, honor our shared values, and the future we are building together. A future where our children can dream without limits, where every family feels safe and welcomed, and where our differences bring us closer rather than divide us. Pa’lante Siempre,
---
| | | Adam GomezState Senator

body:
Hi Peter, I’m not sending this email out to everyone. Just a small group of folks who haven’t yet pitched in to support our campaign.*
I’m reaching out because we have a federally mandated deadline coming up at midnight tonight, and a recent poll has us narrowly _trailing_ Mike Rogers by 1.4 points.
Showcasing our grassroots strength ahead of that deadline was already important, and now that there’s a poll showing we’re behind, it’s even _more_ crucial.
**Can you make your first donation to help us generate as much grassroots support as possible before tonight's FEC deadline?**
[**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-ms-aes-20261014-1-ak**](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20261014-1-ak.Q8HoGK&amount=5&refcode=em20261014-3551&t=2&akid=3551%2E251025%2ErKV4Nh)
After tonight's deadline, our fundraising numbers will be filed in a public report for everyone to see.
Our report tells the whole country — including Mike Rogers, Donald Trump, Elon Musk, and the MAGA donor network bankrolling their efforts — whether this campaign still has momentum.
I know we have the team to show up big and scare off the MAGA mega donors. We just need to prove it in the numbers we file after tonight.
I've never taken a dollar from a corporate PAC, and I never will. That means this report gets built entirely by people like _you_ , Peter.
**You’ve already shown up to support this campaign by being a part of our team. Now, I’m asking you to take the next step by making your first donation before midnight.**
Can I count on you, Peter? Pitch in $5 or any amount today:
[**https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-ms-aes-20261014-1-ak**](https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/507?c0=em-ms-aes-20261014-1-ak.Q8HoGK&amount=5&refcode=em20261014-3551&t=3&akid=3551%2E251025%2ErKV4Nh)
Your friend in the fight,
Abdul
* **P.S.** Our records take time to update. If you’ve donated recently by check or using a different email address, that may not be reflected here. We are so grateful for your support!

name: Citizens Alliance New Hampshire
subject: Let's Send Julie Miles Back to Concord!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Citizens Alliance of New Hampshire, Dan Gray, Treasurer, 45 Lafayette Rd
body:
Election Day is just three weeks away, and Hillsborough County families continue to face higher prices on housing, energy, and everyday necessities...

| | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/n9AGnaKcPYx?e=8c8e704ee6&c2id=4e2c30752203ec2a90a0c0afb040bd70)
| | | | | | Peter,

Election Day is just three weeks away, and Hillsborough County families continue to face higher prices on housing, energy, and everyday necessities while some in Concord look for new ways to tax and spend you into poverty.

**Citizens Alliance of New Hampshire is proud to endorse State Representative Julie Miles for re-election in Hillsborough 12, bringing our **[**total number of endorsed candidates**](https://us.list-manage.com/4rzKmLeGZkV?e=8c8e704ee6&c2id=4e2c30752203ec2a90a0c0afb040bd70)**to 155.**

Julie has signed [The Pledge](https://us.list-manage.com/au9T_PZDGNW?e=8c8e704ee6&c2id=4e2c30752203ec2a90a0c0afb040bd70) and put her commitment in writing to limited government, individual liberty, parental choice in education, and the constitutional freedoms that define the Live Free or Die spirit.
[JOIN US IN SUPPORTING OUR 155 ENDORSED CANDIDATES >>>](https://us.list-manage.com/QZOyc8yMuzW?e=8c8e704ee6&c2id=4e2c30752203ec2a90a0c0afb040bd70)
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/PSc3USZmbIN?e=8c8e704ee6&c2id=4e2c30752203ec2a90a0c0afb040bd70)
| [JOIN THE FIGHT TO GET JULIE MILES OVER THE FINISH LINE ON ELECTION DAY >>>](https://us.list-manage.com/BBp1fWxWLOh?e=8c8e704ee6&c2id=4e2c30752203ec2a90a0c0afb040bd70)
---
| | **Julie is a working critical care nurse who understands what’s at stake...**

She is seeking another term to keep pushing back against rising costs for families, expand parental choice in education, and protect the rights of law-abiding citizens.

She has made clear that a **sales tax and a state income tax have no place in New Hampshire** , and she will continue working to keep both off the table.

**Sending another signer to Concord strengthens the fight for educational freedom, lower taxes, and a state government that stays in its proper place.**

Hillsborough 12 is one more district where a consistent supporter of those values can make a difference. Small margins decide many House races, so turnout and personal conversations with neighbors will decide whether Julie returns to represent the district.

Our teams are knocking doors around the clock across the state. Your support keeps those liberty door knockers in the field until polls close on Tuesday, November 3.

[Sponsoring a door knocker for $175 puts another volunteer on the street talking with voters and building the Red Wall!
](https://us.list-manage.com/JP7vTQ75V5T?e=8c8e704ee6&c2id=4e2c30752203ec2a90a0c0afb040bd70)
To see a full list of our endorsed candidates, go to: [CitizensAllianceNH.org/endorsements](https://us.list-manage.com/Av2KUrsWvBP?e=8c8e704ee6&c2id=4e2c30752203ec2a90a0c0afb040bd70)

Make a plan to vote on Election Day, and LET’S WIN!

Shawn Packard, founder of Red Claw Media and Maine House in District 64 candidate, joins Steve to dissect how the state of Maine's response to rising deaths in adult disability homes mirrors the long-running failures at the child services department. Shawn was placed in a foster home in Vassalboro as a child and later worked with both former Gov. Paul LePage and the late child welfare advocate Bill Diamond. We talked about the MaineCare Section 21 homes, where we've found deaths that never make the news and a mortality review panel that looks at only a handful of cases. You can find Shawn at packardfor64.com and redclawmedia.com.

body:
Believe it or not, he didn’t make it to the NBA

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/141375592/653367719/-109723252?refcode=email_101426_basketball&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NTY5MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2Y2MyMzRkNC1kM2M3LWYxMTEtYmY1Yi0wMDBkM2E0ZmJlODMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=swaJZReSicHMumLE7-9tSzv8-EqoREa98NGDMnGsQHo=) See that short kid in the front, Derek? I know it might be hard to believe, but he didn’t make it to the NBA. Not even close. In fact, that kid got cut from his college basketball team his freshman year. But not long after, he found a new path. He ran for student government... and won. He added more outdoor lights on campus, blue light security phones, and even improved the shuttle service at night. He saw what committed, commonsense leadership could accomplish. So when he won a state House district Republicans controlled for twenty consecutive years, he got to work — and helped pass some of the toughest ethics laws in Pennsylvania history. As Attorney General, he worked to protect healthcare access for Pennsylvanians, get justice for survivors, and defend our democracy from Donald Trump. And now as Governor? When a voter calls **833-DEM-VOTE** , they get connected directly to trained election workers and a rapid-response team of volunteer attorneys ready to resolve issues in real time.
_**🛡️ How You Can Step Up Today:**_

Peter,

This weekend, Donald Trump attacked me on Truth Social, again, calling me a "total fraud" and "radical." He also gave his "complete and total endorsement" to his handpicked candidate Michael Whatley.
He then woke up Monday morning, opened Truth Social and continued his dishonest diatribes. This is not the first time Trump has come after me, and it won't be the last. I just found out that he's coming back to North Carolina _next week_ to continue spreading more lies.
But these recent attacks tell us one very important thing: Trump knows if Democrats flip this seat, then the MAGA agenda is in trouble, and he still thinks Whatley can win this race. And he's right.
**[If you've heard enough, consider donating $5, or whatever you can today before our last FEC deadline TONIGHT.](https://substack.com/redirect/2dba70da-9a5e-4715-a901-d75648a3c1d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/2dba70da-9a5e-4715-a901-d75648a3c1d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Some national Republicans have quit concentrating on winning North Carolina. But Donald Trump is still here, still focused on North Carolina, still spreading lies about me and still propping up Whatley every chance he's gotten.
**You don 't spend that kind of energy on a race you think you've lost**. Trump and his allies still think they can win this critical Senate seat, but we can't let them.
Just last week, President Obama's top strategist David Plouffe warned Democrats not to take North Carolina for granted, and that we can't rest easy just yet.
This race is going to be a tough fight all the way until polls close, and we can't let Trump's attacks turn the tide against us. But people are paying attention, and national news outlets have picked up on these attacks, adding fuel to the fire.
We've built a strong grassroots movement that has grounded us through this campaign, and the momentum we've built is real. But there is no time to get comfortable, especially with Trump coming back to North Carolina on Monday.
**We need to stay ahead of the lies and keep reaching voters in every corner of the state. But I can 't do that without your support. [If you're ready to fight back, please chip in $5 before our final FEC deadline TONIGHT.](https://substack.com/redirect/2dba70da-9a5e-4715-a901-d75648a3c1d3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**

Every contribution, no matter the size, tells Trump and Whatley that North Carolinians and - our people-powered movement - are strong, and we're not going anywhere.
Thank you for standing with me.
Roy

**Q &A with Nancy******
Since Congressman Smucker won’t debate Nancy, we thought we’d ask her some questions so you can get to know her better before you cast your vote on November 3.
**Why did you decide to run for Congress?** When Congress started making deep cuts to Medicaid and other programs that protect our most vulnerable neighbors, I knew I had to speak up. In my career as a Registered Nurse, I know what happens when people can’t get the care they need. A manageable illness that could have been treated with a $10 medication becomes an emergency or an ICU stay, families are buried in medical debt, and sometimes lives are put at risk. I needed to be the voice for those who could not be heard.
After speaking about these concerns at a community event, local Democratic leaders encouraged me to run. I didn’t see myself as a candidate at first, but my husband said, “You’ve been preparing for this your entire life.” He was right. Nursing has taught me to listen, advocate, work with all kinds of people, and make sound decisions under pressure. I’m running to bring those skills—and some much-needed compassion and accountability—to Congress.
**What frustrates you the most about the state of Congress today?** Too many members of Congress seem to have forgotten who they work for. They avoid their constituents, won’t defend their voting records, and spend too much time on partisan distractions instead of the problems families are dealing with every day. I believe the job is pretty simple: show up, listen—even when someone disagrees with you—and be accountable for your decisions. Congress also needs to take its constitutional responsibilities seriously and put real guardrails around our democracy.
**Why do you feel you are qualified to serve as our next Congresswoman?** For more than 40 years, I’ve worked as an emergency nurse and healthcare leader. That means I’m used to listening carefully, thinking clearly under pressure, and making decisions when the stakes are high. I’ve learned how to communicate with people from all walks of life, how to build strong teams that bring people together, and find practical solutions even when resources are limited.
I’ve led healthcare organizations and boards, worked with health systems and governments around the world, and run a small business. I won’t pretend to know everything—but I know how to ask the right questions, learn from experts, and get things done. Most importantly, I’ll represent everyone in this district with integrity, accountability, and compassion.
**What are your top three priorities once in office?** First, I want to make healthcare more affordable and easier to access. That means protecting Medicaid and Medicare, tackling medical debt, and moving us toward coverage for everyone. Second, I want to strengthen public education and workforce training, so people have a real path to good jobs and greater opportunities. Third, I want an economy that works for the people of Lancaster and York counties. I’ll support our farmers and small businesses, work to lower costs for families, and fight to bring federal resources home for housing, food security, and safer communities. You can read more about my priorities [here](https://matj3.r.a.d.sendibm1.com/mk/cl/f/sh/1t6Af4OiGsGQ0v2YvQCvMSCfQRLRNh/GYMxpdeTI9wu).
**Why do some people refer to you as “Dr. Mannion?”** I earned a doctorate degree, along with a bachelor and masters degree. Along the way, I studied healthcare leadership, evidence-based practice, and governance. I’m proud of that education because it taught me to look closely at the facts, ask good questions, and base decisions on the best evidence available—not on personal opinion.
**You’ve spent time overseas doing humanitarian work. What lessons did you take from that work?** That work taught me, more than anything, that every person has worth and deserves to be treated with dignity. It also taught me that you don’t arrive with all the answers. You listen to local communities, work alongside them, and build solutions together.
I also saw how humanitarian aid benefits the United States. American farmers supplied nutritional food, and American companies made lifesaving medicines used in the communities where I volunteered. Helping people abroad builds trust and goodwill, but it also supports people and businesses here at home. Compassion and smart investment really do make all of us stronger.
**What’s your favorite thing about living in Pennsylvania’s 11th Congressional District?** It’s hard to choose just one thing, but I love the mix of community and countryside. People here look out for one another, step up when someone needs help, and take real pride in our farms, small businesses, and towns.
And I have to admit, one of my favorite ways to enjoy this area is taking “Ruby”—my red 1973 Triumph TR6—for a drive along the back roads on a beautiful fall day. The scenery is wonderful, but it’s the people and their spirit of service that truly make PA-11 feel like home.

clean_body: | | | For breaking news follow us on social media | | | | | ---|--- | | | | | | | 20 DAYS TO ELECTION DAY NOVEMBER 3, 2026 ---|--- HELP US REACH EVERY VOTER We have just 20 days to get our message into every corner of PA-11 and make sure voters know they have a choice on November 3. | | Reaching voters takes resources. Billboards, digital and traditional media advertising, mail, signs, and organizing across the district all cost money. Your contribution today will help us reach more voters and build the campaign we need to win! ---|--- | You Can Find Nancy At These Upcoming Events: New Freedom Town Hall – Thursday, October 15, 7:00 – 8:30pm, New Freedom Community Center, 150 East Main Street, New Freedom. More details . Columbia Halloween Parade – Thursday, October 22, the parade steps off at 7:00pm. Volunteers are welcome to walk with Nancy. More details . York Halloween Parade – Sunday, October 25, the parade steps off at 2:00pm**. Volunteers are welcome to walk with Nancy. More details . Q &A with Nancy** Since Congressman Smucker won’t debate Nancy, we thought we’d ask her some questions so you can get to know her better before you cast your vote on November 3. Why did you decide to run for Congress? When Congress started making deep cuts to Medicaid and other programs that protect our most vulnerable neighbors, I knew I had to speak up. In my career as a Registered Nurse, I know what happens when people can’t get the care they need. A manageable illness that could have been treated with a $10 medication becomes an emergency or an ICU stay, families are buried in medical debt, and sometimes lives are put at risk. I needed to be the voice for those who could not be heard. After speaking about these concerns at a community event, local Democratic leaders encouraged me to run. I didn’t see myself as a candidate at first, but my husband said, “You’ve been preparing for this your entire life.” He was right. Nursing has taught me to listen, advocate, work with all kinds of people, and make sound decisions under pressure. I’m running to bring those skills—and some much-needed compassion and accountability—to Congress. What frustrates you the most about the state of Congress today? Too many members of Congress seem to have forgotten who they work for. They avoid their constituents, won’t defend their voting records, and spend too much time on partisan distractions instead of the problems families are dealing with every day. I believe the job is pretty simple: show up, listen—even when someone disagrees with you—and be accountable for your decisions. Congress also needs to take its constitutional responsibilities seriously and put real guardrails around our democracy. Why do you feel you are qualified to serve as our next Congresswoman? For more than 40 years, I’ve worked as an emergency nurse and healthcare leader. That means I’m used to listening carefully, thinking clearly under pressure, and making decisions when the stakes are high. I’ve learned how to communicate with people from all walks of life, how to build strong teams that bring people together, and find practical solutions even when resources are limited. I’ve led healthcare organizations and boards, worked with health systems and governments around the world, and run a small business. I won’t pretend to know everything—but I know how to ask the right questions, learn from experts, and get things done. Most importantly, I’ll represent everyone in this district with integrity, accountability, and compassion. What are your top three priorities once in office? First, I want to make healthcare more affordable and easier to access. That means protecting Medicaid and Medicare, tackling medical debt, and moving us toward coverage for everyone. Second, I want to strengthen public education and workforce training, so people have a real path to good jobs and greater opportunities. Third, I want an economy that works for the people of Lancaster and York counties. I’ll support our farmers and small businesses, work to lower costs for families, and fight to bring federal resources home for housing, food security, and safer communities. You can read more about my priorities . Why do some people refer to you as “Dr. Mannion?” I earned a doctorate degree, along with a bachelor and masters degree. Along the way, I studied healthcare leadership, evidence-based practice, and governance. I’m proud of that education because it taught me to look closely at the facts, ask good questions, and base decisions on the best evidence available—not on personal opinion. You’ve spent time overseas doing humanitarian work. What lessons did you take from that work? That work taught me, more than anything, that every person has worth and deserves to be treated with dignity. It also taught me that you don’t arrive with all the answers. You listen to local communities, work alongside them, and build solutions together. I also saw how humanitarian aid benefits the United States. American farmers supplied nutritional food, and American companies made lifesaving medicines used in the communities where I volunteered. Helping people abroad builds trust and goodwill, but it also supports people and businesses here at home. Compassion and smart investment really do make all of us stronger. What’s your favorite thing about living in Pennsylvania’s 11th Congressional District? It’s hard to choose just one thing, but I love the mix of community and countryside. People here look out for one another, step up when someone needs help, and take real pride in our farms, small businesses, and towns. And I have to admit, one of my favorite ways to enjoy this area is taking “Ruby”—my red 1973 Triumph TR6—for a drive along the back roads on a beautiful fall day. The scenery is wonderful, but it’s the people and their spirit of service that truly make PA-11 feel like home. | ✉️ Enjoying These Campaign Updates? The most interesting story in American immigration policy right now is not happening at the border. It's happening in white papers. Four of them, published over the past eighteen months, by four organizations that most Americans have never heard of, describing -- in sober, footnoted, foundation-funded prose -- a future in which the placement of immigrants into American towns becomes a designed, data-driven, privately administered process.
None of these documents became law. All of them are real. And read together, they sketch something that hasn't yet happened but now has a complete paper trail: a system for deciding which American communities receive newcomers -- and, just as notably, for deciding how those communities should feel about it.
Start with the concept.
**The concept: a visa for fading places...**

Derek –
I'm asking voters to rehire me because the work is not done. Wherever I go, I hear frustration and concern from Virginians: Costs are out of control, from health care, to housing, to child care and utility bills. Our country has been propelled into another war of choice in the Middle East. The job market is shifting beneath our feet.
And the president doesn’t seem to have a plan. He doesn’t even seem to care. And his administration is in over its head.
But it’s not lost on me, we have to do more than just stand against President Trump. We've got to have a positive vision to bring the country back together:
🏥 It's time for us to no longer try to simply patch our old health care system. We need universal health care.
💾 We need to be ready for the amount of change brought by artificial intelligence. There will be good things, but we've got to ensure we don't have massive job dislocation coming out of the AI transformation.
🇺🇸 We've got to stand up for America's critical role in the world, and we need somebody that can work with folks across the aisle to find common ground and restore our leadership on the world stage.
⚡ We've got to find ways to bring energy prices down, which means ending Trump’s assault on renewable energy.
🏠 We got to address the housing crisis by encouraging rehabilitation of existing structures, speeding up permitting, and making it easier for first-time homebuyers to obtain their first mortgage.
The path forward will not be easy but I’ve never been afraid of a tough fight.
I'm going to campaign this year – as I always have – by getting out on the road, talking to voters face-to-face, telling them about my record, and most importantly showing them what I'll do if I get rehired.
And the next few weeks will be hugely consequential to the outcome of November’s election. We’ve got many investments to make in voter outreach, dozens of trips across Virginia to plan, and hundreds more volunteers to recruit.
A donation made today is an investment in the future we’re building together – and it truly couldn’t come at a more important time for our campaign or our country.

body:
Donald Trump’s fascism and abuse of power has now come to my literal front door.
[](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20261014-partner-io.i3LBsN&amount=5&refcode=em20261014-1206&t=1&akid=1206%2E34582%2EhK8yWE)
Peter, Donald Trump’s fascism and abuse of power has now come to my literal front door.
DHS agents raided and searched my home in the DC area as the latest step in their ludicrous, partisan investigation into my immigration status.
I have been in Trump’s crosshairs for years, but now he is escalating in a desperate attempt to drag me and the entire progressive movement down ahead of the midterms.
**[This is a critical moment for our democracy, and we must be decisive. Please, stand by me and our movement today by rushing a contribution, split between me and Small Town PAC, to help me fight back in the face of Trump’s abuse of power »](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20261014-partner-io.i3LBsN&amount=5&refcode=em20261014-1206&t=2&akid=1206%2E34582%2EhK8yWE)**
**[Donate $5 ››](https://act.timwalz.com/go/73?c0=stp-ms-em-20261014-partner-io.i3LBsN&amount=5&refcode=20261014-1206&t=3&akid=1206%2E34582%2EhK8yWE)**
It’s no accident that this raid comes three weeks before an election where I’m on the ballot.
This is part of the fascist playbook to rile up Trump’s die-hard supporters and give them a big distraction in advance of the midterms. With this obviously political investigation, Trump is telling his voters: **‘Ignore the price of gas, ignore the war in Iran, ignore that you’re losing your healthcare — we want you to get angry about _this_ instead.”**
Throughout his presidency, Trump has weaponized the DOJ to target his political opponents, manufacturing charges that have been roundly dismissed by court after court. And I’m not even the first member of Congress to be targeted. The point is to waste everyone’s time and resources, and generate negative headlines for his opponents.
**I will repeat what I have long said: This is a ludicrous investigation, and Trump’s escalation is only further proof that he is willing to use the power of the federal government to try to intimidate and silence anyone who stands up to him. It’s up to us to make sure it doesn’t work.**

Being completely transparent here, Peter. We’re looking for a HUGE number of donations to come through in the next 24 hours if our campaign is going to beat Mike Lawler and flip NY-17 blue. Today might just be the biggest day of the entire campaign. Let’s break it down: Tonight, Cait takes the stage to debate Mike Lawler for the last time before Election Day. All eyes are on our campaign right now. And to be completely transparent—we’ve still got a ways to go on our fundraising goals for tonight. Our budget is completely stretched at this point. If we come up short, every dollar that we don’t raise is a dollar that has to come out of our operations. That means fewer doors knocked and fewer TV ads. This close to Election Day, we think you’ll agree that that simply isn’t an option. So today we’re asking, very humbly: [Please. **WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 14, 2026**
"Hermanos no pelean," my mother would say. As a child, it was a conundrum; we are siblings yet we fought. As a mother, I realized her words weren't a description of reality, but an appeal for peace--a way to preserve the bond so the work of caring for us could continue.
A family is bound by more than agreement. We disagree, question, and sometimes disappoint one another. Yet the bond asks us to keep showing up, to care for one another, and to carry our share of responsibility.
We want that same sense of belonging elsewhere: to share a purpose, to stand with others, to know we are not alone. There is strength in that bond, too.
But what happens when belonging comes with a price?
When agreement becomes proof of loyalty, questions begin to look like betrayal. We defend the leader, excuse the conduct, and measure success by whether our side wins.
Yet winning can become its own kind of loss. In protecting the group at all costs, we may sacrifice the judgment, principles, and responsibilities that gave our allegiance meaning in the first place.
What have we won if, to win, we surrender what mattered?
**Pause.**
**Breathe.**
**Look Deeper.**
**Refuel.**
**Welcome to Sweet Ground.**
